title: Consumer Privacy Choice in Online Advertising: Who Opts Out and at What Cost to Industry?
authors: Garrett A. Johnson; Scott K. Shriver; Shaoyin Du
eligible_reason: No staggered panel design, and the data are simulated. The cost estimates are impression-level regressions of ad prices on cookie type (opt-out, cookied, cookieless), a multi-valued categorical. They use site FE and browser, region, day and hour dummies, with probability weights. The 'DID' columns add an indicator for users who switch cookie status, but there is no user FE and no switch-date structure. The opt-out rate regressions are cross-sectional OLS on regional covariates.
design_notes: main_do.do: reg/areg log1p_dsp_payment i.cookie_type_ndx [controls] [pweight=wt_imp], absorb(taghwsite_cc), cluster(fp_id4), by country. Versions add lagged cookie-count meta controls and cookie_type x browser/region interactions. The DiD block adds ind_switch5 on the subsample of switchers plus cookied/cookieless impressions. Revenue regressions follow for DSP, platform, SSP and publisher. Cross-sectional OLS of logit opt-out rate on city/state covariates. comp_ME*.do compute marginal and market effects.
software_notes: Stata do-files; R for the map.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. The README states that the source data are under NDA and that SIMULATED datasets are provided.
